video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners what a SQL window function is, using a sales table where every sale is shown beside its team total

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

question_mark_enter.what: A large violet question mark fades in in the empty last column of the table

grouped_exit.what: The small GROUP BY result and its label fade away

result_header_light.what: The header of the last column turns from pale to violet and shows the word 'total'

column_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the empty last column

column_ring_exit.what: The outline around the last column fades away

window_draw.what: A violet outline, the window, draws itself around the rows the calculation can see

value_out.what: The old value in the last column slides up and fades out
value_out.scene: PARTITION BY, running total, other functions

value_in.what: A new value slides up into the last column of a row
value_in.scene: OVER, PARTITION BY, row by row, other functions

query_line_out.what: A line of the query slides up and fades out
query_line_out.scene: PARTITION BY, running total, other functions

query_line_in.what: A new line of the query slides up into its place
query_line_in.scene: PARTITION BY, running total, other functions

total_marks_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind each value in the last column

rows_sort.what: The rows of the table slide past each other so the amounts run from smallest to largest

window_grow_enter.what: A violet window outline fades in around the first row only

window_grow.what: The violet window stretches down to take in one more row

header_swap.what: The header word 'total' fades out and 'rank' fades in

final_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the last column of the table
